name: Build and Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*.*.*"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            artifact: desktop-test-app-linux-x86_64
            ext: ""
          - platform: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            artifact: desktop-test-app-macos-arm64
            ext: ""
          - platform: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            artifact: desktop-test-app-macos-x86_64
            ext: ""
          - platform: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            artifact: desktop-test-app-windows-x86_64
            ext: ".exe"

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Linux dependencies
        if: matrix.platform == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libappindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            patchelf \
            libxdo-dev \
            libx11-dev \
            libxcb1-dev \
            libxrandr-dev \
            libdbus-1-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            pkg-config

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Rust cache
        uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: "./src-tauri -> target"

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Install Tauri CLI
        run: npm install -g @tauri-apps/cli

      - name: Build
        run: tauri build --target ${{ matrix.target }} --ci
        env:
          TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY: ""

      # ── Collect the binary/bundle ──────────────────────────────────────

      - name: Collect artifact (Linux binary + .deb)
        if: matrix.platform == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: |
          # AppImage — self-contained, no install needed
          APPIMAGE=$(find src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/bundle/appimage -name "*.AppImage" | head -1)
          cp "$APPIMAGE" "${{ matrix.artifact }}.AppImage"
          # .deb — for dpkg -i install in sandbox tests
          DEB=$(find src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/bundle/deb -name "*.deb" | head -1)
          cp "$DEB" "desktop-test-app_amd64.deb"

      - name: Collect artifact (macOS)
        if: startsWith(matrix.platform, 'macos')
        run: |
          cp src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/desktop-test-app \
             ${{ matrix.artifact }}

      - name: Collect artifact (Windows)
        if: matrix.platform == 'windows-latest'
        run: |
          Copy-Item "src-tauri/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/desktop-test-app.exe" `
                    "${{ matrix.artifact }}${{ matrix.ext }}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: matrix.platform == 'ubuntu-latest'
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact }}-appimage
          path: ${{ matrix.artifact }}.AppImage
          if-no-files-found: error

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: matrix.platform == 'ubuntu-latest'
        with:
          name: desktop-test-app-deb
          path: desktop-test-app_amd64.deb
          if-no-files-found: error

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: "!startsWith(matrix.platform, 'ubuntu')"
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact }}
          path: ${{ matrix.artifact }}${{ matrix.ext }}
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: List artifacts
        run: ls -lh artifacts/

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          files: artifacts/*
          generate_release_notes: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

[package]
name = "desktop-test-app"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Desktop input event logger for sandbox interface testing"
authors = ["TryCua"]
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "desktop_test_app_lib"
crate-type = ["staticlib", "cdylib", "rlib"]

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = [] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
axum = "0.8"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
arboard = "3"
std-semaphore = "0.1"

[profile.release]
strip = true
opt-level = "z"
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

# desktop-test-app

Tauri v2 desktop app that logs all input events (mouse, keyboard, clipboard) to an HTTP API on port **6769**. Used by [cua-sandbox](https://github.com/trycua/cua) integration tests to verify `sb.*` interface methods on Linux, macOS, and Windows sandboxes.

Mirrors the pattern of [android-touch-test-app](https://github.com/trycua/android-touch-test-app) for desktop platforms.

## HTTP API

| Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|
| `GET /health` | 200 OK when ready |
| `GET /events` | JSON array of all input events since last reset |
| `POST /reset` | Clear event log → `{"cleared": N}` |
| `GET /clipboard` | Current clipboard text → `{"text": "..."}` |
| `GET /window-title` | Active window title → `{"title": "..."}` |
| `GET /screen-size` | Screen dimensions → `{"width": W, "height": H}` |

## Event types

| `type` | `details` |
|---|---|
| `mouse_click` | x, y, button |
| `mouse_right_click` | x, y |
| `mouse_double_click` | x, y, button |
| `mouse_move` | x, y |
| `mouse_scroll` | x, y, delta_x, delta_y |
| `mouse_down` | x, y, button |
| `mouse_up` | x, y, button |
| `mouse_drag` | start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y |
| `key_down` | key, code, modifiers[] |
| `key_up` | key, code, modifiers[] |
| `type_text` | text (current input value) |
| `clipboard_change` | text |

## Download

```python
_BASE = "https://github.com/trycua/desktop-test-app/releases/latest/download"
_URLS = {
    "linux":       f"{_BASE}/desktop-test-app-linux-x86_64",
    "macos-arm64": f"{_BASE}/desktop-test-app-macos-arm64",
    "macos-x86":   f"{_BASE}/desktop-test-app-macos-x86_64",
    "windows":     f"{_BASE}/desktop-test-app-windows-x86_64.exe",
}
```

## Use in tests

```python
from cua_sandbox.runtime.compat import skip_if_unsupported
from cua_sandbox.image import Image
from cua_sandbox.sandbox import Sandbox

async def test_mouse_click():
    skip_if_unsupported(Image.linux())
    image = Image.linux().copy("/tmp/desktop-test-app-linux-x86_64", "/tmp/test-app")
    async with Sandbox.ephemeral(image, local=True) as sb:
        await sb.shell.run("chmod +x /tmp/test-app && /tmp/test-app &")
        await _wait_for_health(sb)  # polls GET /health
        await sb.shell.run("curl -s -X POST http://localhost:6769/reset")
        await sb.mouse.click(500, 400)
        import asyncio; await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        r = await sb.shell.run("curl -s http://localhost:6769/events")
        events = json.loads(r.stdout)
        assert any(e["type"] == "mouse_click" for e in events)
```

## Build locally

```bash
cargo install tauri-cli
tauri build
```
